issue.title: [Bug] omp 自动切换思考强度后，Routing 仍显示会话初始强度
issue.body:
## 问题描述

使用 omp 通过 Magpie 网关调用 Codex 订阅模型，已在 Magpie 的 omp 设置中将“新会话默认思考强度”设为 `auto`。

同一会话、同一轮回答中，两边显示不一致：

- omp TUI 显示思考强度为 `high`。
- Magpie Routing 页面显示同一模型正在“以 low 推理强度回答”。

希望确认 Routing 是否遗漏了客户端发送的会话内强度更新，以及这些更新是否会影响实际推理效果。

## 环境

- 客户端：omp 18.13.1
- 系统：Linux
- 调用链：omp → Magpie 网关 → Codex 订阅账号
- 模型：`magpie/codex/gpt-6.1-sol`
- 新会话默认思考强度：`auto`

## 出现过程与已核对记录

1. 在自动思考模式下启动 omp 会话，首轮选择 `low`。
2. 同一会话后续的用户请求被 omp 自动选为 `high`。
3. omp TUI 显示 `high`，但 Magpie Routing 仍显示 `low`，后续请求也继续显示 `low`。

本地记录对应如下，时间为 UTC+8：

- 2026-10-27 23:00:44：omp 记录 `thinkingLevel: low`、`configured: auto`。
- 2026-10-27 23:01:38：omp 记录 `thinkingLevel: high`、`configured: auto`。
- 后续 Magpie 路由记录中的请求 `effort` 和尝试 `effort` 仍为 `low`，未记录规则或成员固定强度覆盖。

## 源码分析

### omp 保留顶层初始强度，通过更新项表达后续切档

omp 的 `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-configuration-update.ts` 中，`planStableOpenAIEffort` 会保留首次请求的 `baseEffort`，将后续强度变化写入 `input` 中的 `configuration_update`。

直接运行该源码函数，首次 `low`、随后 `high` 时得到的关键字段为：

```json
{
  "reasoning": {
    "effort": "low"
  },
  "input": [
    "...既有历史...",
    {
      "type": "configuration_update",
      "reasoning": {
        "effort": "high"
      }
    },
    "...本轮用户消息..."
  ]
}
```

以上为规划器输出的结构示意，不是此次真实上游请求的抓包。

### Magpie 的强度提取只读取顶层字段

`internal/gateway/decide.go` 的 `requestEffort` 对 Responses 请求调用 `bodyEffort`；后者位于 `internal/gateway/gateway.go`，只读取顶层 `reasoning.effort`，没有计算 `input` 中强度更新后的值。

Routing 的 `internal/gui/assets/plugins/routing/client.js` 再使用尝试记录的 `effort` 生成“以 low 推理强度正在回答”的文字。

这与观察到的现象一致：omp 显示本轮选择的 `high`，Routing 显示仍保留在顶层的初始 `low`。

### 客户端自带更新项会跳过 Magpie 自身的升档处理

`internal/gateway/effort_update.go` 的 `withEffortUpdates` 在发现输入含有 `configuration_update` 时会提前返回。

## 期望行为

- Routing 能识别客户端的 `configuration_update`，正确显示当前请求更新后的强度。
- 如果同时保留顶层初始强度，能明确区分“初始强度”与“更新后强度”，避免将初始值描述为当前回答强度。

comments.body:
Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3918-effort-update, commit aeb51d64 on origin/main f8cd964a (applies as is on f8cd964a), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout f8cd964a..aeb51d64 | sha256sum` is `7285660e306d1190c3e3f3a3bd716ff441b9185d25210c28a5d6371e9e70b5f2`.

原因就是你找到的那处：magpie 只读顶层的 reasoning.effort，而 omp 把会话第一轮的 low 一直留在顶层，之后的切档写成 input 里的 configuration_update。这个补丁让 Routing、请求记录、用量和按思考强度写的规则都读 input 里最后一个 configuration_update 的强度，没有才读顶层，你这个例子现在显示 high。发出去的请求我没改：走 Codex 订阅账号时这个条目本来就原样到了 ChatGPT 后端，所以实际推理确实是按 high 跑的，只是 #617 里有人直连后端测过，往上调的更新给的推理量偏少，gpt-6.1-sol 顶层 low 是 328 个推理 token，顶层 high 是 826，low 再加一个调到 high 的更新是 513。走其他 Responses 服务商或者要转协议的路线时，magpie 会把这个条目去掉，模型按顶层的 low 跑，记录里会写它是按 low 发出去的，这部分另开在 #3941，要怎么改得你定。我按你给的请求形状写了测试，在 main 上先红后绿；没试过的是 omp 连真实的 Codex 账号跑一遍。

原因：`internal/gateway/decide.go` 的 `requestEffort` 对 Responses 请求只读顶层 `reasoning.effort`。omp 在 auto 下把会话首个强度留在顶层，把之后的切档写成 `input` 里的 `configuration_update` 项，所以 Magpie 记下的始终是会话初始的 `low`，Routing 也照它显示。发给 Codex/ChatGPT 后端时这些项本来就原样转发，`high` 是实际在用的强度，错的只是记录与显示。

分支 `fix/3918-omp-effort-routing` 的改动：

- Responses 请求的强度改读 `input` 中最后一个 `configuration_update` 的 `reasoning.effort`（`updatedEffort`，`internal/gateway/effort_update.go`）；没有这类项时仍读顶层，行为不变。Routing 的请求行、尝试行和用量因此记录本节实际使用的强度。
- 同一份读取也用于翻译给其它 API 的请求（`readResponses`）：`configuration_update` 无法翻译过去，之前会把初始的 `low` 发给 Chat/Anthropic 成员，现在按当前强度发送。
- 请求体本身不改写，`withEffortUpdates` 照旧跳过带客户端更新项的请求，Magpie 自己的升档处理不受影响。

[fix/3918-omp-effort-routing](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3918-omp-effort-routing), commit 51e60b3bdec1f6f445b14da635443fcb8df963b1

运行：`go test ./internal/gateway/ -run 'TestResponsesEffortUpdateIsTheRoutingEffort|TestRequestEffort' -count=1`（修复前 `route "low", try "low"; want "high"` 失败；只改显示读取时 `route "high", try "low", sent low; want high` 失败；修复后 6 passed）；`gofmt -l`、`go build ./...`、`go vet ./internal/gateway/` 均无输出。`go test ./internal/gateway/ -count=1` 未跑完，超过五分钟被中断，未记为通过。

这是 fork 分支，待 review，不是对 issue 归属的声明。
skygunner 这版（51e60b3b）和我那版（aeb51d64）的差别：他的把翻译给 Chat、Anthropic 成员的请求也改成按最后一个 configuration_update 的强度发，就是 #3941 里的第二处；我那版发出去的请求没动，那处留在 #3941 等你定。两版对原样转发的 Responses 请求都不改。

Withdrawing this one: JoeyWu-tech claimed it at 17:37 and posted a patch at 19:09 (`JoeyWu-tech/magpie` branch `fix/3918-effort-update`, commit aeb51d64) before I posted at 20:20, so mine duplicates theirs. The branch `fix/3918-...` stays as a reference; the effort-update behaviour they describe is the same one I changed, and their note comparing the two versions still stands.

Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3918-effort-update-2, commit a0425564 on origin/main f6ed2c99 (applies as is on e9dd8e83), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout f6ed2c99..a0425564 | sha256sum` is `df79a70dd49cc278121f67ebb68fcc85c970db062a23e1d6e694bc6bedad9761`.

还是之前那个改动，旧的 aeb51d64 在现在的 main 上打不上了：f6ed2c99 在 docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md 里加了一条讲强度别名（Trae 的 light 和 extra_high）的说明，正好落在我们加 configuration_update 那条的位置，所以 rebase 到了 f6ed2c99，两条都留着，main 的在前，代码和测试一行没变。commit body 里的记录都在新树上重跑过，没有沿用旧树的：新测试放到 f6ed2c99 上照样红、补丁后绿，-race 也过，七处手动改坏各自红，vet 和全量测试也重跑了。

yetone 10-29 的 fc43c69e5（v0.1.2040 起）已经修了这个：Responses 请求里带 configuration_update 时，强度按最后一个算（effortUpdated），Routing、请求记录和按强度写的规则都跟着变。所以我这个补丁（a0425564）撤回了。

lghnb 你更新以后可以看看 omp 切档后 Routing 是不是跟着变了。我只对了代码，没在 omp 上实测。

issue.title: configuration_update: magpie's own effort loses to the client's item, and routes that drop the item run the conversation's first effort

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Found while fixing #3918. omp on GPT-6 models (and Codex with reasoning_effort_override on) keeps a conversation's first effort at the top of a Responses request and sends each later change as a `{"type":"configuration_update","reasoning":{"effort":"high"}}` input item; the upstream reasons at the last one. The #3918 patch (fix/3918-effort-update) has the route, the try, the usage and the rules read that effort. It leaves what is sent alone, and two things in what is sent are still off.

Where the item reaches the upstream (a ChatGPT account, OpenAI's API, a relay set to take Codex's requests as sent), every effort magpie picks itself is written only at the top: a member fixed at an effort (`codex/gpt-6.1-sol:low`), a rule's useEffort, the turn's pick, the agent pick, a group's levels, the fit to the model's levels and the retries for reasoning off or none (withFixedEffort, withEffort, withBodyEffort, codexSideEffort), and a quiet or reasonless member loses only the top-level reasoning. The client's item still follows in the input, so the upstream runs the client's effort and magpie's choice never takes. To see it: a group with `codex/gpt-6.1-sol:low`, omp on the group at auto effort, a turn omp raises to high. The backend gets reasoning.effort low plus a configuration_update to high. With the #3918 patch the try records what ran, so Routing says "high reasoning, fixed on this model in the group" for a member fixed at low.

Where the item doesn't reach (any other Responses API, since forVendor strips it, and any translated route, since readResponses never reads it), the model runs at the effort at the top, the conversation's first, for the rest of the conversation, while omp shows the one it changed to. Codex never sends that: toward a provider that isn't OpenAI it leaves the items out and puts the current effort at the top (core/src/session/reasoning_effort.rs, and client.rs's `input.retain(|item| !matches!(item, ResponseItem::ConfigurationUpdate { .. }))`), and omp only sends the items to a model it thinks takes them. With the #3918 patch Routing shows the gap (omp asked high, the try went at low), but its fallback line gives the wrong reason: "low reasoning: the model's nearest to the high omp asked for".

What to do is a choice I'd leave to you. For the dropped items, doing what Codex does looks right: on a route that drops them, the last one's effort goes at the top, before magpie's own writes so a fixed member still wins. That changes what those vendors are sent, and the cache restarts wherever the client changes its effort, as it would for Codex itself. For magpie's own effort on a route that keeps the items, either the client's items go when magpie writes its effort (the top is then the turn's, at full strength, the prefix restarting where they're dropped), or magpie's effort goes as one more item (the prefix stays, but #617 measured an update up reasoning at a fraction of the level asked: gpt-6.1-sol updated to xhigh gave 802 reasoning tokens where xhigh at the top gave 3350).
